name: Leah
summary: Laban's older daughter, whom Laban gave to Jacob in place of Rachel. Though Jacob loved Rachel more, Leah became the mother of six of his sons, including Levi and Judah, and of his daughter Dinah.

key_moments.title: The Switched Bride
key_moments.description: Leah had tender eyes, while her sister Rachel was beautiful. Laban brought Leah to Jacob in the evening instead of Rachel, and in the morning Jacob found it was Leah.

key_moments.title: Sons for an Unloved Wife
key_moments.description: When the LORD saw that Leah was unloved, He gave her children. She bore Reuben, Simeon, Levi and Judah, and at Judah's birth she said she would praise the LORD.

key_moments.title: More Sons and a Daughter
key_moments.description: Leah later bore two more sons, Issachar and Zebulun, and then a daughter named Dinah.

key_moments.title: Buried with the Family
key_moments.description: Before he died, Jacob asked to be buried in the cave of Machpelah, where Abraham, Sarah, Isaac and Rebekah lay, and where he had buried Leah.
